infobox.usage: Unlocks the blue post service van in front of the post office on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Rus Post car key (Rus Post) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key for the Rus Post service vehicle. Most likely opens the trunk as well.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a required location for the story chapter Blue Fire

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Streets of Tarkov
sections.text: On the ground next to the back right wheel of the blue post service van in front of the post office. A single key is guaranteed to spawn every raid.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The driver's door and the trunk of the blue post service van in front of the post office at Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text: Nothing unless the story chapter Blue Fire is active.
